description: This file defines the CassandraClusteringOptions class, which provides configuration options for Cassandra-based clustering in Orleans. It includes properties for TTL behavior, retry delays, and methods to configure Cassandra client sessions.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringOptions
classes.description: Provides configuration options for Cassandra clustering in Orleans, including TTL settings, retry delays, and session configuration methods.

methods.name: GetCassandraTtlSeconds
methods.description: Calculates TTL seconds for Cassandra based on cluster membership options if TTL is enabled.

methods.name: ConfigureClient
methods.description: Configures the Cassandra client session using a connection string and keyspace.

methods.name: ConfigureClient
methods.description: Configures the Cassandra client session using a delegate function.
